dial.desc: the round compass dial at the centre: an emerald-enamel dial with fine gold radial lines and rings, an eight-point gold compass star with engraved arms, and a large faceted emerald in the middle

wing.desc: the feathered ivory wing on the right side of the emblem, with a darker emerald-tinted wing tip at the top, layered feathers curling around the gold rim

finial.desc: the sword-hilt finial on top of the emblem: a gold pommel and an emerald-enamel grip with a small gold ornament set with a pointed emerald, rising from the gold rim

pendant.desc: the pointed gold pendant hanging below the emblem, set with a long diamond-shaped faceted emerald
